messages:
maria: kicking off a shadow run of kv-only quant profiles across FP8/INT8 on staging. goal: measure warmup/cold-tail + mem reduction + accuracy delta on our 13B queryset. run id: shadow-2026-04-12-1. full artifacts: s3://redwood-staging/kv-shadow/shadow-2026-04-12-1

deploy-bot: started shadow job shadow-2026-04-12-1 · 1959991300

aj: quick summary from the first 10k queries — FP8 KV-only reduces KV memory ~42% vs FP16, INT8 ~36%. p95 lat: FP8 62ms, INT8 58ms, FP16 70ms. p99.9 tail: FP8 420ms, INT8 380ms. looks like cold-path tail for FP8.

kai: what's the warmup config? are we preloading KV pages or relying on request-driven warming?

maria: warmup config for this run: worker_warmup_requests=4, prefetch_batch_size=8, warmup=true. we did NOT enable proactive prefix caching for this pass.

eva: accuracy spot-check on our 2k eval set: FP8 EM drop ~0.7% relative, INT8 ~0.5% vs FP16 (rerank+answer-f1 metric). these are small but consistent in short-answer prompts.

aj: can you paste the bench command to reproduce?

maria: sure — running locally with curl:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/bench \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"13B-kv-fp8","mode":"kv-only","parallelism":64,"warmup":true}'
```

kai: saw a repeated kernel stall in the logs at ~120k tokens: "kernel_queue_depth=0" entries and worker thrash when eviction fires. suspect compact-on-evict causing page swaps.

maria: for the next run I set kv-compact-on-evict=false and delay_gc_ms=200 to reduce thrash. will re-run with those flags and also test an aggressive prefetch variant.

eva: deployment recommendation based on current numbers: FP8 is best for memory-bound batch workloads but has slightly higher tail. route low-latency, single-query traffic to INT8; send bulk/batched requests to FP8. consider fallback policy if tail > 300ms. :thumbsup:

aj: any NPU/GPU util numbers or cost delta estimates?

maria: GPU mem footprint per-worker (observed): FP16 6.4GB, INT8 4.1GB, FP8 3.7GB. GPU util % similar across variants. unit throughput: FP8 slightly higher for big batches due to denser packing + continuous batching.

kai: for accuracy breakdown, can we split by category (short-answer, multi-turn, code-synth)?

maria: quick numbers: short-answer EM: FP16 0.812, INT8 0.806, FP8 0.805. code-synth F1: FP16 0.744, INT8 0.739, FP8 0.737 — small regressions concentrated on low-frequency tokens.

aj: next steps: 1) aggressive prefetch run (prefetch=32), 2) kv-compact-on-evict=false, 3) longer warmup window (30s), 4) capture p99.95 and cold-start curve, 5) dump top-5 logits diffs for sample set.

eva: also propose a quick shadow in Dedicated to validate eviction under real load and see if tail changes under higher concurrency.

maria: scheduling follow-up run now for 1959992000 with tags: fp8,int8,warmup-profiling,kv-compact-false. will upload results + diffs to s3 and ping back here.

deploy-bot: scheduled shadow job shadow-2026-04-12-1-rev2 -> 1959992000

maria: thanks everyone — will post the summarized CSV + a short notebook with plots once the run completes. (react: :eyes:)
